free_tier.stated: Lifetime Personal 500 GB $229 (from $344); Lifetime Personal+ 2 TB $499 (from $749). One-time, 'No recurring renewal'. Live on the vendor page 2026-10-21.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: 2 sync devices on lifetime, 14 days file versioning

egress.terms: Free-tier bandwidth is capped (TechRadar: 3 GB/day on free). Lifetime paid tiers not metered per-GB; sync-limited to 2 devices on lifetime.

tooling: rclone backend `icedrive`. Third-party clients exist; WebDAV is not native.
chaining: $250/TB at 2 TB. No stacking. Lifetime tiers are fixed capacity.
limits_note: 2 sync devices on lifetime, 14 days file versioning. Vendor explicitly says heavy sync/NAS workloads belong on subscriptions. I.e. the lifetime tier is throttled by device count, not bytes.
reliability_note: Gibraltar-registered ICE PRIVACY LTD, 30-day guarantee on the lifetime page but 14 days in the published conditions. Decide inside 14. Price discrepancy vs the 2026-10-17 audit ($699 for 2 TB) suggests the vendor page is running a deeper promo than third parties track.
